risks.title: Raw material cost inflation and supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Material risk explicitly identified first in risk factors section. Document cites increased raw material costs, wage rates, extended lead times, and potential tariff impacts. Competitive pressures limit ability to pass costs to customers, directly threatening profit margins. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Fluctuations in raw material prices, labor costs, extended lead times, and supply chain interruptions could adversely affect profit margins and operational results if pricing cannot be increased proportionally.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions and trade policy impacts
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as material risk. Document details availability/pricing issues, trade policy changes, tariffs, and retaliatory measures as potential drivers of supply constraints and cost increases affecting margins and operations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Changes in trade policies, supply chain disruptions, duties, tariffs and countermeasures could adversely impact raw material availability and pricing, affecting profit margins and operational results.

risks.title: Cybersecurity threats and data breaches
risks.score_rationale: Standard risk disclosure for manufacturing companies with digital operations. Potential for system breaches, external supplier vulnerabilities, financial/legal consequences, and reputational damage identified as material risks to operations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Cybersecurity breaches in company or supplier systems could result in financial losses, legal liability, operational disruption, and loss of customer confidence.

risks.title: Competitive pressure and pricing dynamics
risks.score_rationale: Identified as material competitive risk. Document indicates pressure from innovative competitors and low-cost providers, combined with customer ability to seek alternative suppliers, creates margin compression and growth challenges. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Competition from innovative and low-cost competitors may require Brady to reduce prices or increase investments, thereby threatening profitability and market position.

risks.title: Digital transformation execution risk
risks.score_rationale: Digital capabilities enhancement is identified as a key strategic competency and growth initiative. Failure to execute digital strategy including website/portal improvements and customer tools could impair competitive positioning and revenue growth. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Failure to effectively develop digital capabilities, enhance transactional websites, and integrate customer portals could limit competitive reach and customer experience versus more digitally advanced competitors.

risks.title: International regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Brady operates across multiple jurisdictions with exposure to varying regulations (data protection, environmental, trade, anti-corruption). Company explicitly identifies compliance expertise as core competency, suggesting material regulatory exposure. Approximately 50% of revenue internationally. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Non-compliance with international regulations spanning data protection, environmental standards, trade laws, and anti-corruption measures could result in fines, legal action, and business disruption.

risks.title: Dependence on key employees and talent retention
risks.score_rationale: Risk is acknowledged but expressed with moderate urgency. Document indicates importance of experienced organization and technical expertise for innovation and customer service, but no imminent talent crisis disclosed. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Loss of key technical and management talent, or inability to attract and retain experienced personnel, could impact product innovation, customer service delivery, and operational performance.

risks.title: Product liability and intellectual property litigation
risks.score_rationale: Standard manufacturing industry risk. Potential exposure to product liability claims, IP disputes, and environmental litigation exists given manufacturing operations and proprietary product portfolio, though no specific incidents disclosed. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Product liability claims, intellectual property disputes, and environmental litigation could result in significant legal costs, settlements, and reputational damage.
